# Pew 2026-06 Why Don’t People Use Chatbots

同一调查：49% 用过、51% 从没用过；不用的人里，不感兴趣、担心个人信息、不信任准确性是主要原因。

- 信源等级：A（人工定级）
- 立场和局限：美国成年人样本；原因是不用者自报。

## 论断

- 「Although chatbot use is rising in the United States, about half of U.S. adults say they never use one, according to Pew Research Center’s February survey of U.S. adults.」— 位置：正文第 1 段 ^c1
- 「Group Ever use Do not ever use U.S. adults total 49% 51%」— 位置：图表 Majority of Americans 50 and older don’t use chatbots（表格行 U.S. adults） ^c2
- 「Not interested in using them 60% 23% 83% Concerned about how their personal information will be used 54% 24% 79% Don’t trust them to give accurate information 45% 30% 76%」— 位置：图表 Lack of interest, concerns around privacy and accuracy…（表格前三行） ^c3
- 「Less than a third point to not knowing how to use chatbots as a major reason why they don’t use it.」— 位置：正文 ^c4

## 抓取原文


> 公开版只收录上面"论断"里的原文摘句，全文请看来源链接。

Although chatbot use is rising in the United States, about half of U.S. adults say they never use one, according to Pew Research Center’s February survey of U.S. adults.

Group Ever use Do not ever use U.S. adults total 49% 51%

Not interested in using them 60% 23% 83% Concerned about how their personal information will be used 54% 24% 79% Don’t trust them to give accurate information 45% 30% 76%

Less than a third point to not knowing how to use chatbots as a major reason why they don’t use it.
